name: hook-integration-test
title: Hook Integration Test — Implement & Test New Claude Code Hook
description: Implements, registers, tests, and documents a new Claude Code hook through exploration, design, implementation, registration, unit testing, and documentation.
author: SolSolis-Sys

inputs.name: plugin_path
inputs.description: Absolute path to plugin root directory (e.g., 'D:/HYPERION/conductor-memory')

inputs.name: output_type
inputs.description: Hook output type: 'systemMessage' (display to user) or 'silent' (write data only)

inputs.name: data_path
inputs.description: Optional path to write data if output_type is 'silent' (e.g., '~/.claude/hooks/plugin-name/data.json')

inputs.name: description
inputs.description: Brief hook description for documentation (e.g., 'Track session open events')

agents.prompt:
Explore the plugin structure and understand existing hooks.

Plugin: {{plugin_name}}
Path: {{plugin_path}}

Your task:
1. Read plugin.json from {{plugin_path}} — understand plugin metadata, version, entry points
2. Check if hooks.json exists at {{plugin_path}}/hooks.json — if yes, read and catalog existing hooks
3. Search for hook implementations in src/ or lib/ directories (look for hook handler patterns)
4. Identify the hook registration mechanism (does the plugin use hooks.json, or register hooks programmatically?)
5. List any dependencies for hook handling (e.g., @anthropic-ai/claude-code-sdk, fs modules)
6. Check tests/ directory for existing hook test patterns

Return JSON:
{
  "plugin_metadata": {"name": "", "version": "", "description": ""},
  "existing_hooks": [{"name": "", "event": "", "output_type": "", "file": ""}],
  "has_hooks_json": true|false,
  "hook_registration_method": "hooks.json|programmatic|unknown",
  "hook_implementations_found": [{"file": "", "hook_name": ""}],
  "hook_dependencies": [],
  "test_patterns_found": [{"file": "", "pattern": ""}],
  "issues": []
}
